lines.text: God tells Zechariah to take an offering from the Babylonian exiles and go to the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah.
Zechariah is to make a silver and gold crown and set it on Joshua son of Jehozadak.
The LORD of Hosts says a man called the Branch will branch out from His place and build the altar.
Even those far away will come and build the temple, if the people diligently obey the LORD their God.
